goalTextEn: Can ask about team members and their roles.
goalTextKr: 팀원과 역할에 대해 질문할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can ask about team members and their roles.
introduce.goalKr: 팀원과 역할에 대해 질문할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: You are joining a new project team. You want to learn who does what, so you ask a coworker about the team members.
introduce.situationKr: 새 프로젝트 팀에 합류합니다. 누가 어떤 일을 하는지 알고 싶어서 동료에게 팀원들에 대해 질문합니다.
introduce.taskEn: Ask about at least 3 team members and their department, team, or responsibility.
introduce.taskKr: 최소 3명의 팀원에 대해 부서, 팀, 또는 담당 업무를 질문해 보세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice asking about teammates at work."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation.
"Let's go to the next part."
Keep the questions short and clear.

patterns.en: Who should I talk to about customer support?
patterns.kr: 고객 지원에 대해서는 누구와 이야기하면 되나요?

vocabulary.definition: one part of a company or office
a job or duty that a person is in charge of
a team working together on one project

tutorNotes.text: "Let's look at questions used when asking about teammates."
Read the first pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to ask about a person's department."
Read the second pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to ask about a team."
Read the third pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to ask about a responsibility."
Read the fourth pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to ask if two people work together."
Read the fifth pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to ask the right person for help."
"Do you have any questions about the patterns?"
"Let's go to the next page."

patternDrills.template: Who should I talk to about ___?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's work on comprehension."
Read the instruction.
"First, let's practice the sentence patterns."
Read each pattern heading, then continue the drill. Ask the student to repeat and complete the blanks.
Focus on one question pattern at a time.
"Do you have any questions? ...Let's go to the next part!"
"Now, let's look at the word bank."
Read each word, then ask the student to repeat.
Correct the student's pronunciation errors if needed.
For lower-level students, read the word and the definition, then ask the student to repeat.
"Do you have any questions? ...Let's go to the next part!"
"Now, let's practice the /w/ and /v/ sounds."
Practice the /w/ words first, then the /v/ words. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach the student how to pronounce /w/ and /v/ with lip position if needed.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.
"Do you have any questions? ...Let's go to the next part."

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. What department does Greg work in?
2. What team is Daniel part of?
3. What is Emma in charge of?
4. Do you work with Oliver?
5. Who should I talk to about customer support?
6. Thanks. That helps a lot.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's practice today's question patterns."
Read the instruction.
Read each sentence. Ask the student to repeat.
Adjust speed according to the student's level.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.
"Nice! Let's go to the next part!"

steps.title: Step 2 - Complete the Questions
steps.instructionEn: Complete the questions with the missing words.
steps.content:
1. What __________ does Greg work in?
2. What team is Daniel __________ of?
3. What is Emma in __________ of?
4. Do you work __________ Oliver?
5. Who should I talk to about customer __________?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, complete the questions."
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to complete each blank, then read the full questions aloud.
Have the student say each question with a natural rising tone.
"Nice! Let's go to the next part!"

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice the dialogue with your tutor. You are asking about the project team.
steps.instructionKr: 선생님과 대화를 연습하세요. 당신은 프로젝트 팀에 대해 질문하고 있습니다.

dialogue.en: Hi! I am Grace from HR. Do you have any questions about the team?
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요! 저는 인사팀의 그레이스입니다. 팀에 대해 궁금한 점이 있나요?

dialogue.en: Yes. What department does Greg work in?
Greg works in the Sales department.
I see. What team is Daniel part of?
He is part of the Project team.
Thanks. What is Emma in charge of?
She is in charge of client visits.
Who should I talk to about customer support?
dialogue.kr: 고객 지원에 대해서는 누구와 이야기하면 되나요?

dialogue.en: You should talk to Chloe about customer support.
dialogue.kr: 고객 지원에 대해서는 클로이와 이야기하면 됩니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's practice the dialogue."
Read the instruction.
"I will read the tutor parts. You will read the student parts."
Do it once while reading, then once again without looking at the screen if possible.
If time permits, switch roles so the student practices answering too.
"Nice! Let's go to the next part!"

steps.title: Step 4 - Ask About the Team
steps.instructionEn: Ask your tutor 4 questions about the team without looking at the screen.
steps.instructionKr: 화면을 보지 않고 선생님에게 팀에 대한 질문 4개를 하세요.
steps.content:
Include:
- one department question
- one team question
- one responsibility question
- one free question

tutorNotes.text: "Now, ask me 4 questions about the team without looking at the screen."
Read the instruction.
Let the student ask freely. Answer naturally, but keep the answers short.
After each question, encourage the student to ask a follow-up question.
If the student gets stuck, point to one pattern and let them try again.
"Nice! Let's go to the next part!"

challenge.scenarioEn: You are meeting Grace from HR before your first team meeting. Ask Grace about the people on the project team. Use today's key expressions to ask about departments, teams, responsibilities, and the right person to talk to.
challenge.scenarioKr: 첫 팀 미팅 전에 인사팀의 그레이스를 만납니다. 프로젝트 팀 사람들에 대해 그레이스에게 질문하세요. 오늘의 핵심 표현을 사용해 부서, 팀, 담당 업무, 그리고 누구와 이야기해야 하는지 물어보세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Now let's do simulation"
"First please read the Key Expressions. You may use the Key Expressions in the Simulation."
Read the simulation.
"Is it clear?" ...Now let's start our roleplay!
Use the prompt questions to guide the roleplay.
Give feedback after finishing.
This must be a real-life simulation, distinct from Practice. Corrections should only be done after the exercise.
Welcome to HR. How can I help you?
Greg works in the Sales department. Do you work with him often?
Daniel is part of the Project team. Have you met him yet?
Emma is in charge of client visits. Do you meet clients too?
Yes, I do. Oliver helps with weekly reports. Who do you work with most?
You should talk to Chloe about customer support. Is there anything else you want to know?

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category, then answer the questions.

categories.title: YOUR TEAM
questions: What team are you part of?
Who is in charge of your biggest task?

categories.title: NEW COWORKERS
questions: What do you want to know about a new coworker first?
Is it easy for you to ask questions in English?
What is a good first question at work?

categories.title: WORKPLACE HELP
questions: Who do you ask for help at work?
Which department do you contact most often?
Why is it important to know each person's role?

tutorNotes.text: "Let's have a discussion about workplace teams."
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to choose a category.
You can ask follow-up questions and have a natural conversation with the student until the time for feedback.
